notes: modelLoadFirstMs is the first ever load in a fresh browser profile (graph compile + parse); warm loads reuse the browser cache.
ingest = 40 chunks through the Web Worker only; writeAndRefresh = HTTP batch + seekdb write + refresh_index.
e2e = click to rendered result, measured by the in-app ×10 benchmark (warm-up run discarded).
Single query embedding is tiny, so E2E is dominated by HTTP + seekdb; bulk embedding is where WebGPU wins (87.5 vs 15.1 chunks/s).
Headless modifier for the WASM run: --disable-gpu, which makes navigator.gpu unusable and triggers the documented fallback banner.
